identity.name: Oceanus Manta Bluetooth Solar
identity.one_liner: Casio's Oceanus line — the high-end titanium G-Shock sister — with a 40mm titanium case, sapphire crystal, Tough Solar radio-controlled accuracy, and Bluetooth for the Japan-only flagship "Manta".

provenance_events.description: Casio releases the Oceanus Manta OCW-T4000A as a 40mm titanium case, sapphire crystal, Tough Solar radio-controlled, Bluetooth, 100m water resistance.

narrative.story: Oceanus is Casio's most-exclusive line — sold only in Japan, in titanium, with sapphire crystals and radio-controlled accuracy. The Manta OCW-T4000 is the modern flagship: 40mm titanium case, sapphire crystal, Tough Solar radio-controlled, Bluetooth for time-setting.
narrative.collector_notes: The case is 40mm titanium with a polished finish, which wears lighter than the steel equivalent. The dial is a sun-ray blue with applied indices.
